scope: Finite original CUDA R1/R2 RequestLoop model-EOS and cold-capture tuple boundaries, plus unchanged tiny regressions.

build.closure: Each original223-input combined-probe closure replaces exactly Graph and its probe object. No SDK rebuild or separate Model/CLI duplicate.

correctness.EOS: The independent EOS arms use the original default Qwen stop policy, genuine vocabulary IDs248044/248046, and an actually accepted native B. A commits EOS; B retires with no publication. R2 peer survives and continues as R1.
correctness.cold_tuple: Separate cold-tuple arms intentionally ignore model EOS. After original imported capture is warmed and idle, replace the actual successor output owner, retaining the old backing. Original Graph bind revokes that capture; pending B refuses without recording/submitting; A and the subsequent ordinary path retain correct state.
correctness.equality: Serial versus relay generated IDs and original committed ledger facts, epochs, initialized KV/GDN/conv payloads, pending and RNG agree at comparable prefixes. Physical pages/padding are excluded. R2 ledger quota is checked against each actual credit and normalized only across serial/relay comparisons; membership is checked against actual batches.
unrun: Original tiny R1 late extra-stop arm remains UNRUN because no unique token occurs at its warmed predecessor boundary. The independent wide-vocabulary default-EOS arm does not change that fact.
No injected native fault, MTP successor, continuous pipeline, non-CUDA backend, task quality or performance result is claimed.

fixtures.payload_hash_validation: Generated body SHA256 values are the actual CPU-build owner receipt, with current size checked here; not recomputed by this package. Reused original source and each selected range SHA256 are verified here.
fixtures.limitations: Untrained complete GA one-hot fixtures with zero residual output projections. Original state-producing branches still execute, but outputs give no trained-model quality, accuracy or real speed conclusion. Constructor and small manifests are included; all weight payloads excluded.

archive.boundary: Commands, frozen source/header closure, dependency/link SHA receipts and logs permit reproduction with the retained external toolchain/cache. This archive does not redistribute SDKs, libraries, binaries or weights.
